messages:
micah: Quick pulse on OptKit milestone E2 — can we confirm owners for canary + metrics and call out any blockers for quantization/batching/cache rollout?

jia: I have the quant recs PR up: https://git.redwood/optkit/pull/482. Perf looks good on L4-rt (---15% p99 tokens) but we have a small regression on BLEU for the reranker tests.

omar: Runtime heads-up: KV cache refactor (eng-runtime#210) needs one more perf tweak. If that lands after the canary it could change our latency profile. ETA for fix ~tomorrow EOD.

micah: @omar thanks — do you expect any infra downtime or config changes for the canary?

omar: No downtime. We'll need an extra feature-flag flip and a small config tweak: set `cache.max_prefix=1024` for the canary nodes. I'll post the rollout snippet.

micah: canary owner? @tess?

tess: I can own canary + rollback. Will need a list of metrics and alert thresholds. Also need the PRs that touch batching and the exact image tags for the canary run.

anya: Dashboard links: https://dash.redwood/optkit/canary and https://dash.redwood/optkit/quality. Suggested alerts: token p50 > 120ms, token p99 > 350ms, rerank BLEU drop > 1.5 pts. I added these as a draft rule.

jia: PRs to watch: quant recs (PR#482), batching heuristic tweak (PR#487), prefix-cache toggle (PR#490). CI green for 482 but flaky on rerank tests.

deploy-bot: CI status — 482: ✅ (unit, integration), 487: ✅, 490: ❌ (integration: kv-cache-integration) — see logs: ```Error: timeout waiting for cache node registration
cmd: kubectl logs -n runtime cache-node-2```

tess: ok I'll wait for 490 to be green before starting canary. ping @omar to triage the cache registration.

omar: investigating now. early suspicion: bootstrap race when pod gets attached to the new sidecar. Fix is a 2-line readiness probe tweak, sending patch.

micah: timeline ask — we'd like a short canary tomorrow morning PST, full rollout Friday if all green. Is that still realistic?

jia: If we stabilize rerank test (I can run a focused eval suite this evening) and 490 is fixed, yes. Else we should delay 24h.

anya: I'll wire up a temporary regression alert against the rerank eval set so we get automatic notifications if BLEU drops during canary.

tess: owner checklist I need: PR URLs, canary image tags, who will monitor (primary/secondary), rollback playbook snippet. I'll draft a tiny runbook and post here.

micah: great. last ask — code-review pings: @jia can you add Omar as reviewer on 482 and 490? makes sense for runtime/infra eyes.

jia: added Omar + Tess to both. Also tagging @micah for final signoff on the rollback thresholds.

deploy-bot: Patch submitted for readiness probe tweak on eng-runtime#214, CI queued.

omar: FYI once probe patch merges I'll trigger a staged redeploy in staging and re-run the integration job. Will report back within 2 hrs. :eyes:

micah: thanks all — please drop quick status updates here as you go. :thumbsup:
